comment: No control on this module carries a configParam name, so an untagged control would show nothing at all. The panel names differ from the code's names for three controls: the knob printed SWEEP is kickPitchMax, the knob printed ROLL is bassVelocity, and the jack printed BAR is the clock input. The four text readouts and the bass waveform graph are Label and draw() artwork, not parameters, so they cannot be clicked.
